stem: Nora plans to watch the Lab B demonstration. What complete instruction fits?
options: Go to Lab B at 16:20 and wear goggles.
Go to Lab A at 16:20 without goggles.

optionRationales.reason: Go to Lab B at 16:20 and wear goggles.：表格給 16:20 DEMO，附註要求 goggles。
Go to Lab A at 16:20 without goggles.：地點錯且缺必需品。
Go to the Yard at 17:10.：Yard 活動取消。
Buy a Nut Bar to enter Lab B.：菜單品項不是資格。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「主表或圖表提供的數值與 NOTE 限制同時套用後只剩一個可行方案」可推出 Go to Lab B at 16:20 and wear goggles.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Go to Lab B at 16:20 and wear goggles. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
